name: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance - Collector's Binder
description:
Radiance is taking the stage!
Keep your Riftbound collection protected and organized with the Collector’s Binder - Radiance. Designed for durability and ease of use, this binder features side-loading pockets and a secure zippered closure to keep cards in place. Holds up to 360 sleeved cards in archival safe pages built for long term storage.

PROTECT YOUR CARDS
・Holds up to 360 sleeved cards in side-loading 9-pocket pages. Durable zippered closure keeps cards secure during storage and transport
imageAlt: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance - Collector's Binder

name: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance Vault Bundle
description:
Break into the Radiance Vault!

This high-value bundle contains a variety of contents that are perfect to compliment a growing Riftbound collection.
Packaged in a reusable storage box, inside you’ll find 6 Booster Packs from Riftbound Set 5: Radiance, 36 basic runes to power your decks, and 3 full art, foil Promo tokens!
imageAlt: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance Vault Bundle

name: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance Evelynn & Seraphine Showdown Deck
description:
Evelynn & Seraphine: Who’s topping the charts and who’s facing the music? Find out with these Showdown Decks.
Jump into play with two 56-card preconstructed decks, two paper playmats, two booster packs, and a rulebook. Expand your collection or play with a friend! Either way, these Showdown Decks strike the perfect chord.
Includes 2 Riftbound: Radiance boosters!
imageAlt: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance Evelynn & Seraphine Showdown Deck

name: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance Booster Display
description:
The fifth set for Riftbound: League of Legends TCG is putting even more champions in the spotlight! These 14-card booster packs pull from a pool of 180 cards with more than 60 Showcase cards, including all new legends, units, spells, new mechanics, and more.

● CHAMPION YOUR STRATEGY
Build your deck from premium packs filled with 7 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 2 foil Rares or better, 1 foil of any rarity, and 1 token slot. Each booster display contains 24 booster packs.

Booster boxes will not leave unopened; they must be opened inside the association.
imageAlt: Riftbound: League of Legends TCG - Radiance Booster Display
